page.overview:
Who is Bill Pye?

Bill Pye is a radio broadcaster, and a possible relative of Arnie Pye.

He was on the radio Some Enchanted Evening, he announces that Marvin Monroe will be on soon, then his broadcast forwards to Marvin. He doesn’t make any more appearances after this, as he was presumably replaced by Arnie Pye.

Bill was later replaced by Arnie Pye, Bill may be a relative, as they have the same name.
